descriptionChirho: A proper noun identifying the city of Kedesh, a significant Canaanite and later Israelite city. Refers primarily to Kedesh in Naphtali, designated as a city of refuge (Josh 12:22, 19:37, 20:7, 21:32; Judg 4:6,9-11; 2 Kgs 15:29; 1 Chr 6:61). Also possibly Kedesh in Issachar (1 Chr 6:57) and Kedesh in the south of Judah (Josh 15:23). Multilingual evidence uniformly transliterates: eng 'Kedesh', spa 'Cedes/Kedesh', hin केदेश, arb قَادَشَ, kor 게데시/게데스, swa 'Kedeshi'. Prepositional forms (S131339, 'to/from Kedesh') are syntactic variants, not a distinct sense.
